text:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release v3.7.1 -> eu-west-1 pool. rollout 100% completed at 1746209988. rollout-id: r-2026-03-20-eu. details: https://deploys.internal/release/r-2026-03-20-eu
maria: noticed an anomaly in the post-deploy quick checks — heartbeat probe for model-variant 'v3-opt' showing several failed pings in the last 6m (6/30). p95 latency jumped to 800ms for a short window.
raj: looking at the metrics now. there is a correlated spike in KV cache misses and a small fanout of 502/504s on the postgen path. pulling logs.
raj: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-20T09:12:34Z] ERROR postgen-handler: upstream read timeout (upstream=embedder-01)
[2026-03-20T09:12:35Z] WARN kvcache: miss key=prefix/abc123 warmup=false
[2026-03-20T09:12:36Z] INFO router: routing to variant v3-opt
```
sam: also seeing nginx 504s climb from 0.8% -> 4.9% after the rollout finished. looks like a latency tail combined with cache cold starts.
maria: can we decide quickly — pin back to the previous variant (20240315) for eu-west while we investigate? prefer to do a short hold rather than a full rollback. need decision in ~10m.
raj: agree with holding traffic on the previous stable variant. suggested plan:
  1) pin routing for eu-west-1 to variant id `20240315` (legacy)
  2) run extended health pings (5m windows x 6 rounds) + synthetic end-to-end sample set
  3) monitor p95 and error-rate; if errors <= 1% and p95 < 250ms, consider re-ramping with 5% increments
  4) file follow-up to investigate kv cache warmup and kernel scheduling for v3-opt

maria: +1 for plan. can we do a targeted pin (gateway-level) rather than redeploy? that'll be faster.
sam: i'll apply the routing pin now via the routing API. command:```
curl -X POST https://gateway.internal/api/v1/route/pin \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","service":"model-serving","variant":"20240315","note":"post-deploy pin due to heartbeat ping drift"}'
```
deploy-bot: routing change applied: region=eu-west-1, service=model-serving, pinned_variant=20240315, change_id=chg-89023 at 1746210200.
maria: running a quick health probe run now:```
# from perf-runner
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://eu-west-1.api.internal/model/v1/health/ping
# expect: 200 and <0.25s
```
raj: initial telemetry after pin: p95 back to ~210ms, error-rate dropped to 0.9%. synthetic sample set passed 92/100. will keep monitoring for the next 60m.
sam: updating release notes and changelog: "held rollout for v3-opt; pinned to stable variant 20240315 due to liveness ping drift and increased KV cache misses. follow-up: investigate cache warmup and scheduling."
maria: thanks — i'll mark the release as on hold in the weekly deploy tracker and create a JIRA for the follow-up (INF-1429).
raj: once we confirm stability after 60m, recommend reattempting a slow ramp with extra cache-warmup steps (gradual traffic increases + warming synthetic seeds).
sam: noted. will coordinate a throttled re-rollout and add a pre-warm job to the pipeline. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: automatic rollback policy not triggered (threshold not met). manual pin applied by sam.
maria: closing thread for now, we'll reconvene if metrics regress. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
